basics.name: Albert Xu
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer with hands-on experience in backend APIs, cloud deployment, and frontend frameworks. Proven ability to build scalable applications, automate workflows, and contribute to research on data quality in AI systems. Passionate about engineering elegant solutions to real-world problems.

work.name: 4Pexonic Inc.
work.summary: Developed an academic impact analysis platform tracking citation patterns and research influence using Node.js, MongoDB, and Next.js with Docker containerization, serving university researchers and policy institutions.
highlights: Built two-tier caching with in-process LRU and Redis for bibliometric queries, reducing response times by 40% for complex research trend analysis and cross-disciplinary impact calculations.

Integrated gRPC microservices for data processing pipelines and implemented secure authentication with bcrypt/session management, configured Nginx SSL to protect academic publication data and researcher information.

Created API documentation for citation tracking endpoints, established monitoring for data accuracy validation, and collaborated with QA team on bibliometric testing protocols, improving system reliability by 25%.

work.name: UCSD ECE Department
work.summary: Developed the ITA Workshop website with video/document upload functionality using Django and React, serving 1000+ users with Redis server-side caching and optimized SQL indexes for improved page load performance.
highlights: Refactored file upload system to asynchronous chunked processing, enabling large video and document handling while maintaining ACID-safe database schema changes and improving overall system throughput.
Implemented multipart S3 uploads with SHA-256 integrity checks and PostgreSQL performance tuning, achieving high-throughput file transfers with cross-region replication for data durability.

work.name: Spesland
work.summary: Led development of AI-driven government platform GovChat used in 200+ cities.
highlights: Built Dockerized services using Node.js/Express, MongoDB, and Next.js, reducing setup time by 60%.
Integrated GPU-powered LLM microservices for city services, achieving 200ms average latency.
Implemented TLS termination with Nginx/Certbot and secure authentication, reaching 99.9% uptime.

work.name: UCSD Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute
work.summary: Created tools to inject and analyze data quality issues in ML workflows.
highlights: Improved model fairness by 15% and accuracy by 10% through error injection framework.
Executed robustness evaluations on data cleaning tools and ML models.
Enhanced bias injection precision using Z-score normalization, improving attack capability by 30%.
